def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    occurrences = [120, 80, 50, 40, 30]

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    sorted_occurrences = sorted(occurrences, reverse=True)
    total_complaints = sum(occurrences)
    top_two_complaints = sum(sorted_occurrences[:2])
    answer = round((top_two_complaints / total_complaints) * 100, 2)

    # return answer
    return answer
